name: ParceladoUSA Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
author: parceladousa

sections.description:
ParceladoUSA Payment Gateway for WooCommerce allows you to accept payments from Brazilian customers with flexible installment options. This plugin integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce and supports both the classic checkout and the new WooCommerce Checkout Block.

Features:

  • Accept payments in BRL and USD
  • Support for Brazilian Portuguese and English
  • Seamless integration with WooCommerce
  • NEW: Full support for WooCommerce Checkout Block
  • NEW: Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)
  • External payment page for secure transactions
  • Automatic order status updates via webhooks
  • Sandbox and production environments

Requirements:

  • WooCommerce 5.4 or higher
  • PHP 7.2 or higher
  • Valid ParceladoUSA merchant account

Additional Information

For more information, visit ParceladoUSA or check the GitHub repository.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/parceladousa-payment-gateway-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  4. Enable ParceladoUSA and click “Manage” to configure.
  5. Enter your Public Key and Store Code from your ParceladoUSA account.
  6. Select your environment (Sandbox for testing, Production for live transactions).
  7. Save changes and test the checkout process.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support WooCommerce Blocks?

Yes! Version 1.2.0 adds full support for the WooCommerce Checkout Block while maintaining backward compatibility with the classic checkout.

Which currencies are supported?

Currently, the plugin supports BRL (Brazilian Real) and USD (US Dollar).

Do I need a ParceladoUSA account?

Yes, you need to register at ParceladoUSA.com to obtain your API credentials (Public Key and Store Code).

Is it compatible with HPOS?

Yes, version 1.2.0 is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
